answer: Sybil resistance relies on reputation with an exponential temporal half-life: identities must provide sustained, honest service to maintain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because trusted peers have not endorsed them; reciprocity-weighted transitivity constrains borrowed trust. Unlike a river crossing a mesa toward the ocean, endorsements cannot simply flow around missing trust links, so new sybils cannot meet consensus thresholds unaided.
